svg.title: MTP and DFlash2 speculative decoding at long context on Arc Pro
svg.desc: Social card for the original August 19 sweep, with MTP leading at 32K and 128K input, the modes meeting at 256K, and DFlash2 leading at 512K on four Arc Pro B70 GPUs.
